headline: Global Crude Steel Output Falls 1.1% in October as China Cuts Production
summary: World crude steel production fell 1.1% year-on-year in October due to production cuts in China. Conversely, Türkiye's crude steel output increased 5.5% to 3.4 million tons.
why: The World Steel Association tracks global crude steel production, a key indicator of industrial demand and infrastructure activity.

impacts.name: Steel
impacts.why: Global steel output fell 1.1% as Chinese steelmakers reduced production.
